title: Dutch van der Linde's last words in Red Dead Redemption
subject: dutch
description:
Was Dutch a villain or just lost? 👇

Dutch's choice on the mountain, the standoff at Mount Hagen and his final moment in 1911. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2 and Red Dead Redemption.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: On a mountain in 1899, Dutch van der Linde simply walked away.
Arthur Morgan, sick with tuberculosis, stood between him and Micah Bell, the man who had sold the gang out.
Dutch looked at both of them and left without a word.
Eight years later, John Marston and Sadie Adler tracked Micah to Mount Hagen. Dutch was waiting there.
In the standoff, Dutch shot Micah, then walked away again.
In 1911, the government sent John after him. They met on a cliff at Cochinay.
Dutch told him, "Our time has passed, John," and stepped back off the edge.
